newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. regulators extend talks with 3 utilities.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. regulators extend talks with 3 utilities.

text.p: New York Public Service Commission has extended restructuring talks with three utilities, saying a settlement agreement seems feasible.

In notices issued Wednesday, the commission said circumstances have changed sufficiently that Chairman John O'Mara determined to extend to March 10 from Feb 28 the filing deadlines for Central Hudson Gas & Electric Corp, Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc and Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc.

Commission spokesman Dave Flanagan said Thursday talks continue with the other two utilities -- New York State Electric and Gas Corp and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp -- that made filings October 1 in the commission's competitive opportunity proceeding.
The commission exempted the state's two other electric utilities -- Niagara Mohawk Power Corp and Long Island Lighting Co -- from the proceeding.
The extended talks involve the three utilities' plans for electric rates and restructuring, and Con Edison's proposal to form a holding company. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
